meta.description: Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides two numbers. It is read where its output goes in, so alpha, random or path_info on a or b give every path, point or instance its own value.

op_type.description: What it does with a and b: add, subtract, multiply or divide (a / b).
op_type.label: type

a.description: The first number, the one b is subtracted from or divided by.
